original_card.acceptance_gate: State the exact formalized proposition and remaining assumptions; avoid duplicate arithmetic formalizations already present.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one missing statement with quantified hypotheses, actual caller and existing coverage. A compact-switch lemma is a candidate only after its mathematical contract is reviewed. Establish a bounded proof plan before a separately budgeted proof-assistant build; do not rerun large Lean jobs as orientation.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A missing interface proof can reduce the conditional gap even if it does not change kappa.

scope_change_triggers: Formalizing already-covered arithmetic and claiming the full multiplication theorem.

actual_scope: Exact rank/unrank bijection and finite-fair-bit uniform sampler for invertible prime-field completions with a prescribed injection and two arbitrary simultaneous capacities.
scope_change_reason: The source PR6539 leaves uniform sampling open. This is a written constructive interface proof rather than a Lean formalization or an audit of a selected assumption.
bottleneck_link: Side result for shared-map basis selection: converts a coupled static count into explicit completions. Physical/native/caller admission remains separate.
stop_rule: Stop after the first verified enumerative construction; direct polynomial-time sampling and physical realization remain open.
evidence: PROOF.md and verify.py; exact literal rank/unrank endpoints, finite-bit distribution census, large selected round trips and rejection controls.

open_questions.question: Can a direct uniform sampler realize the quotient/lift factors in polynomially many field operations?

open_questions.first_step: Construct uniform common injections with the prescribed quotient discrepancy and track lift multiplicities.
open_questions.blocked_by: Compatible lift multiplicities must remain exact across both capacities.
